text:
Maya (VP Eng): thanks everyone for the all-hands. reopening this thread for detailed follow-ups on runtime roadmap (perf, batching, kernels). post quick bullets.
Arjun (Sr SWE): quick Q — do we push for p99.9 tail reductions for interactive paths or optimize median latency across all routes? customers complain about spikes.
Maya (VP Eng): p99.9 for paid tiers is top priority; lower tiers can accept best-effort. we need cost impact first.
Priya (Runtime PM): proposing SLO tiers: paid p99.9 < 60ms, paid p95 < 30ms. need eng sign-off on feasibility.
Jin (ML Eng): kernel update: fused-attn gives ~18% throughput on H100 @2k seq, but on our int8/4-bit quant path it's closer to 7%. we should validate memory patterns.
Arjun (Sr SWE): Jin, can you publish a bench matrix per model? I'll use it to estimate tokens/$ delta.
Jin (ML Eng): will add models: redwood-instruct-2b, orca-7b-mini, mistral-8k. uploading results to /bench/results.
Omar (SRE): ops noise — GC thrash seen during heavy KV access on dedicated pools. looks like prefetch parallelism is too high and triggers eviction storms.
Priya (Runtime PM): action: limit prefetch parallelism to 4 and add backpressure to router. I'll open a PR for the runtime change.
Maya (VP Eng): rollback condition: if p95 increases >5ms within 30m of rollout revert changes. document in the runbook.
Arjun (Sr SWE): rollout strategy for kernel changes: staged canary with A/B routing. 10% -> 25% -> 100%. include a deterministic selector for lab repro.
Jin (ML Eng): agree on deterministic kernel selector. also need an automatic fallback path to the reference kernel if OOM or correctness alerts fire.
Priya (Runtime PM): owners & timeline: Arjun (canary orchestration), Jin (kernel builds/bench), Omar (obs + alerts). PoC due in 10 days.
MetricsBot: canary snapshot created: 2391234400 by Arjun :white_check_mark:
Priya (Runtime PM): telemetry ask: preserve batch-size histograms and kv-eviction rates for 90 days for offline analysis.
Omar (SRE): storage cost estimate ~1.2TB/month at full retention. propose sampling 1-in-5 (20%) for histograms to cut cost.
Maya (VP Eng): approved: sample 20% for metrics retention; keep full retention for alerts/incident windows.
Arjun (Sr SWE): product ask: expose per-tenant max-batch-size and priority lanes in Console so we can throttle noisy tenants.
Priya (Runtime PM): Console work scoped Q2; MVP will include coarse-grained tenant knobs (max-batch, priority lane).
Jin (ML Eng): quality/regression control: add quantization A/B checks in canary pipeline. Priya please add QA prompts to measure quality delta at each step.
Priya (Runtime PM): will add QA suite to canary job and require pass for progressing canary stages.
Omar (SRE): tickets: RD-5120 (eviction dashboards), RD-5121 (canary auto-rollback rules).
Arjun (Sr SWE): I'll open the canary orchestration spike branch today and post link.
Jin (ML Eng): kernels uploaded to ci:build/2391, bench logs to /bench/results/2391.
MetricsBot: archived thread logs 2391234567
Priya (Runtime PM): updated roadmap doc with owners & dates: https://go.redwood/internal/runtime-roadmap (internal)
Maya (VP Eng): thanks all, keeping this open for 24h for any blockers. if none, we'll close and track via tickets. :sparkles:
